source.title: Forebears Cabo Verde forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized Portuguese/Cabo Verdean given names and surnames. Gender buckets are based on public name usage patterns and are not an official civil registry export.

source.title: ITU National Numbering Plans: Cabo Verde (+238)

phones.notes: ITU lists Cabo Verde under country code +238. Public numbering summaries based on ITU data describe a seven-digit closed plan with mobile/non-geographic ranges beginning 9, 59, and 330. Kept sample_verified rather than verified because the exact current country-specific ITU allocation table was not directly extracted into this dataset.

national_identification_card_number.label: National Identification Card (CNI)

source.title: Portal Consular Cabo Verde: National Identification Card

national_identification_card_number.notes: Official consular portal confirms the CNI as a state-created identity document. A public secondary description gives a 13-digit civil identification number shape, but no official public checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed here, so generation remains template-only synthetic.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: Portal Unico Cabo Verde: nationality and citizenship services

passport.notes: Official service portal confirms Cabo Verde passport services. No public official passport-number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was found; the value is a conservative synthetic placeholder only.
